# Punt FT%: Player Targets

**Summary.** Punt FT% works in our league only if you keep buying assists, threes and steals after the big men. Giannis is the anchor at about 60 to 62 USD. Barnes, Sengun, Daniels and Mobley are the core, and the cheap centers (Kessler, Gobert, Claxton) fill rebounds, blocks and FG%. None of the listed targets brings threes, so you must buy 3PTM from guards outside this list, or the build quietly punts four categories.

## The trap: punting four categories

The experts agree on the main risk. Free throws are linked to points, threes and assists. If you draft only bad free throw shooters, you effectively punt four categories, not one. In a 12-team H2H league, losing FT%, 3PTM, AST and PTS most weeks loses the matchup. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=568), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=323))

The rule for our auction: after you buy a guard-stat-poor anchor like Giannis, two of your next three buys should be players who bring assists, threes or steals. The original advice is 'guards in two of the next three rounds'. In an auction, that means checking your roster after every purchase in the first hour. If you are missing assists or threes, raise your bids on guards, not on another big man. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=756), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=561), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=323))

Check this list before the draft. No player below is credited with threes in the notes. Daniels, Ausar Thompson, Zion, Gobert and Claxton actively hurt 3PTM. So every three you need has to come from players outside this target list. Plan to buy 3PTM with real money in the early and middle rounds. ([Dyson Daniels](../profiles/players/dyson-daniels.md), [Ausar Thompson](../profiles/players/ausar-thompson.md), [Zion Williamson](../profiles/players/zion-williamson.md), [Rudy Gobert](../profiles/players/rudy-gobert.md), [Nic Claxton](../profiles/players/nic-claxton.md))

## Do you have to punt FT% with Giannis?

The experts disagree here. One side says taking Giannis in round one does not force you to punt free throws or to target other bad shooters. Your targets after him are still every player. The other side says that if you draft a bad free throw shooter like Giannis, you should punt FT% and get guard stats early. His profile note also says to build around punting FT% and accept the turnovers. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=856), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=524), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=323), [Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md))

Both sides agree on what to do in practice. Do not chase low free throw players for their own sake. Buy the best player at a fair price, and treat poor FT% as a discount you can absorb, not a reason to bid. ([09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=561), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=2379))

## Pricing rules for punt targets

Do not push up players who gain value in punt rankings just to secure them. Other managers in our league will also see that Sengun or Kessler rank higher with FT% removed. Set a ceiling before the draft and walk away when it is passed. For example, the notes say not to go above about 30 USD for Sengun, about 12 to 15 USD for Kessler and about 10 USD for Zion. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=2379), [Alperen Sengun](../profiles/players/alperen-sengun.md), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md), [Zion Williamson](../profiles/players/zion-williamson.md))

Overall 9-cat ranks can mislead you. If you punt FT%, a drop in a player's free throw shooting barely matters to you, even if his overall rank falls a lot. That is why Siakam (about 72% FT) and Mobley look better to a punter than to a balanced team. Mobley is worth less in a build that keeps FT%. ([07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=2097), [Pascal Siakam](../profiles/players/pascal-siakam.md), [Evan Mobley](../profiles/players/evan-mobley.md))

Do not choose the punt because of one bad season. FT% swings a lot in both directions, and it is the most variable fantasy category. Price a poor shooter as if his free throws will stay bad, and treat any improvement as a bonus. Mobley is the test case: experts are watching whether his FT% climbs back toward 70%. ([08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=1274), [08-11](https://youtu.be/OdDkXFhoKsc?t=714), [Evan Mobley](../profiles/players/evan-mobley.md))

## Late centers, waivers and minutes

The cheap centers in this pool all give the same package: FG%, rebounds and blocks. Buy one or two late instead of paying middle-round prices. Gobert, Kessler and Claxton cover this. Robinson and Nurkic are better left on waivers in our 144-player draft. ([Rudy Gobert](../profiles/players/rudy-gobert.md), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md), [Nic Claxton](../profiles/players/nic-claxton.md), [Mitchell Robinson](../profiles/players/mitchell-robinson.md), [Jusuf Nurkić](../profiles/players/jusuf-nurkic.md))

A poor free throw shooter who starts is partly protected from hack-a-player fouling, because there are no team fouls early in the game. So in the first weeks, check starting jobs: Claxton ahead of Jalen Smith and Zach Collins, Robinson versus Queta, and Nurkic versus Jaxson Hayes after his return. Use your FAB and the six weekly adds on the one who wins the job. ([07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=1790), [Nic Claxton](../profiles/players/nic-claxton.md), [Mitchell Robinson](../profiles/players/mitchell-robinson.md), [Jusuf Nurkić](../profiles/players/jusuf-nurkic.md))

Check playoff schedules for weeks 19 to 21 before the trade deadline on 2027-03-04. Miami (Giannis) and Houston (Sengun) have weak 10-game playoff schedules, though Miami has no back-to-backs in those weeks. Mobley faces a 2-game finals week. Gobert has a two-game semifinal week. If you hold several of them, plan a deadline trade or streaming adds to cover those weeks. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [Alperen Sengun](../profiles/players/alperen-sengun.md), [Evan Mobley](../profiles/players/evan-mobley.md), [Rudy Gobert](../profiles/players/rudy-gobert.md))
